title: HALO local model loading and failure cleanup
alt: HALO local model loading and failure cleanup
caption: The actual Kotlin model-loading path: check the model and tokenizer, bootstrap Qualcomm QNN, load the ExecuTorch module and clean up on failure. This is implementation evidence; it is not a phone UI capture or a latency benchmark.

title: Lithium niobate bend geometry and simulation regions
alt: Lithium niobate bend geometry and simulation regions
caption: An archived bend iteration showing the 3D core, input/output guides, source, monitor and simulation regions. Its 1.83 µm width and 1 µm height belong to that earlier configuration; the active fabrication stack is described below. This is a geometry visualization, not an optical-field or transmission result.

title: Input and output polygon joins
caption: A geometry diagnostic from the 50 µm bend study, inspecting where the bend meets the straight guides. The visible joins are part of checking the model before interpreting optical results.

title: Centerline, curvature and parameter knots
caption: An earlier parameterization diagnostic: bend shape, curvature along arc length, its numerical derivative and the segment knots. These plots describe the geometry supplied to the solver.

title: Generalized Euler seed reconstruction comparison
caption: A reconstruction check against the reference-paper seed data. This comparison checks the recreated geometry; it is not a new measured device result.

title: Native Zemax model of exposure and camera paths
alt: Native Zemax model of exposure and camera paths
caption: My native OpticStudio study of the shared stepper optics: violet exposure rays and the red camera branch. The objective uses a published Olympus prescription as a proxy; it is not the commercial objective’s internal prescription.

title: Curved objective prescription in OpticStudio
caption: The imported seven-element objective proxy, inspected as curved glass in the native model. It establishes a traceable model for evaluation, with the commercial objective’s internal prescription still unknown.

title: Exposure-path spot diagram at the reference spacing
alt: Exposure-path spot diagram at the reference spacing
caption: The exposure-path check did not pass at the preserved reference spacing. Missing accepted edge-field spots are not zero aberration. This result identifies an optical problem to resolve before claiming printable resolution.
source: William Xu · native OpticStudio spot analysis

title: Original laser-driver power and thermal requirements

title: Electrical, thermal and control requirements
caption: The second notebook page records the 0–3.5 A current range, 12 V source, heatsink/fan considerations and TEC/PID control questions. These are design requirements, not test measurements.
